description: This Java class defines a REST controller for basic utility endpoints, including a welcome message, documentation redirect, health check, and application info, using Spring Boot and Swagger annotations.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing utility endpoints such as welcome message, docs redirection, health check, and app info for the productsbackend.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message indicating the application is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects clients to the Swagger UI documentation page.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a basic health check by returning 'OK'.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns application information string about productsbackend.
